entries.title: OECD Creditor Reporting System (CRS)
entries.description: Development finance by provider, recipient, flow type and sector.

entries.title: OECD DAC1 Total Flows by Provider
entries.description: Each provider's total ODA and other flows by type of aid, including ODA as a share of GNI.

entries.title: OECD DAC2A ODA by Provider and Recipient
entries.description: ODA disbursements by provider and recipient, including imputed multilateral ODA.

entries.title: OECD DAC2B Other Official Flows by Provider and Recipient
entries.description: Other official flows and export credits by provider and recipient.

entries.title: ONE Conversion Tables (DAC)
entries.description: Exchange rates and deflators for converting OECD data to other currencies and constant prices.

entries.title: ONE Imputed Multilateral Sectors
entries.description: ONE's estimate of how providers' core contributions to multilaterals are spent, by recipient and sector.

entries.title: World Bank International Debt Statistics (IDS)
entries.description: External debt of low- and middle-income countries by debtor and creditor.

entries.title: IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO)
entries.description: GDP, savings, capital formation and output gap figures and projections for countries and country groups.

entries.title: ONE Conversion Tables (IMF)
entries.description: Exchange rates and deflators for converting IMF and World Bank data to other currencies and constant prices.

entries.title: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI)
entries.description: Semi-aggregate development finance data from key providers reporting to IATI.

entries.title: WHO Global Health Expenditure Database (GHED)
entries.description: Health spending by country and source, including government, out-of-pocket and external funding.

entries.title: OECD Country Programmable Aid (CPA)
entries.description: The share of ODA that recipient countries can plan and program, by provider and recipient.

entries.title: Total Official Support for Sustainable Development (TOSSD)
entries.description: Official support for sustainable development beyond ODA, including South-South providers and global public goods.

entries.title: ONE Climate Finance Files
entries.description: ONE's estimates of bilateral and multilateral climate finance by provider and recipient.

entries.title: OECD Providers' Total Use of the Multilateral System
entries.description: Each provider's core and earmarked contributions to multilateral organisations.

entries.title: African Debt Database
entries.description: Domestic and external debt instruments issued by African governments, by creditor, currency, maturity and interest rate.

entries.title: World Bank Remittance Flows
entries.description: Migrant remittance inflows and outflows by country, including flows between pairs of countries.

entries.title: ODA nowcasting
entries.description: Develop and test a method for estimating aid before official figures arrive, starting with a case study of health ODA. Publish estimates if the method proves viable.

entries.title: Humanitarian funding
entries.description: Reported humanitarian funding by crisis, provider, and year, using OCHA's Financial Tracking Service.
